== Shared Versions navigator: Dark Side pilot, 13 November 2026 ==
Bill approved a second, reversible family-navigation test after the Premiere Luke pilot. Eleven existing Premiere Darth Vader family articles now share [[Template:Card versions/Darth Vader (Premiere)]]. Every member shows the same list and highlights its own publication. The template has Edit versions and Help links. The Players Committee errata of the Decipher card has its own labeled group; it is not assigned to a Decipher publishing date. Other Vader personas and weapons remain outside this family.

Images, text, lore, identities and other card fields were preserved. Existing source citations received verified preservation links where required. The Unlimited article had two identical copied navigation parameters; these were consolidated into one shared Versions parameter. The English Reflections foil is a publication-inventory follow-up, rather than a fabricated article or image in this navigation pilot. No wider Premiere migration has been performed.
